description: Inspect a known remote artifact: title, kind, current version and file names. Use before editing, to check what files exist, or to review version history and sharing status. Optionally include versions and/or shares; shares require owner permissions and contain summaries and recoverable addresses for new links. Metadata with filenames requires source access (editor or higher). File contents are returned by read (text) or export (original bytes).

include.description: Optional additional details; shares require owner permission. Omit for metadata and filenames only.

share_token.description: Token from a user-provided share URL; carries only that share permission.

slug.description: Artifact identifier returned by find/publish, or the slug in its /s/ URL. Not a local path.

tenant_id.description: Destination tenant for creation; defaults to the account tenant.
